description: Search Fencer Intel entries (CVE, GHSA and OSV advisories merged into one entry per vulnerability). Free text in `q` matches ids, titles, descriptions, vendors, products and package names; structured parameters narrow the result. `published` is the CVE publish date. `listed_since` is when the entry became news here, and `kev_added_since` is the day CISA added it to KEV (both an ISO date or timestamp; a KEV time cuts on that UTC day). Each result says why it matched; when nothing matches, `broader` lists relaxed queries that do return results.

exploited.description: Only entries known exploited (KEV) or with a public exploit (Exploit-DB or Metasploit).

kev.description: Only entries in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

kev_added_since.description: ISO date or timestamp. Only entries CISA added to KEV on or after that UTC day (2026-11-08T15:00:00Z keeps 2026-11-08). With no `q`, no `listed_since` and no `sort`, results are ordered by that date, then id; an explicit `sort` wins.

listed_since.description: ISO date or timestamp. Only entries whose `listed` (when the entry became news here, not its publish date) is at or after it.

published.description: CVE publish date: 2024, 2024-05, 2024-01-01 (that day), 2024-01-01..2024-03-31, >=2024-01-01, <2024-01-01, or a relative window such as 1d or 30d. Anything else is an error.

q.description: Free text, an exact id such as CVE-2021-44228 or GHSA-jfh8-c2jp-5v3q, or a name a vulnerability is known by (Log4Shell, Heartbleed).

sort.description: Order. relevance (default with q): matches in the id, title, products or packages first, then in CISA KEV, critical, newest. newest (default without q), severity, or epss (most likely exploited first).

vendor.description: Vendor or product name, matched from the start of a word ("micro" finds Microsoft), e.g. "fortinet".

name: search
title: Search vulnerabilities
